standards.name: Medical Subject Headings (MeSH)
standards.abstract: Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) is a controlled, hierarchically organized thesaurus produced and maintained by the U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM) for indexing, cataloging, and searching biomedical and health-related information (notably MEDLINE/PubMed). The MeSH resource includes Descriptors, Qualifiers (subheadings), and Supplementary Concept Records (SCRs); it is updated on an annual cycle for descriptor releases with continual/daily updates for SCRs, and is available in multiple machine-readable formats (XML, RDF) with APIs and browser tools for access. The standard addresses the need for consistent subject indexing and retrieval across biomedical literature and library catalogs.

classification.rationale: The source material includes a genuine, structured two-column table titled 'Publication Characteristics (Publication Types) with Scope Notes' where each row names a Publication Type and provides a corresponding Scope Note (i.e., distinct named fields with concrete text values). This is presented as a tabular metadata-style listing rather than only prose guidance, so the document supports extraction as a MetadataTable.

PublicationType.name: Publication Type
PublicationType.descr: Name of the publication characteristic / publication type used in MeSH (controlled term naming the type of publication, e.g., Abbreviations, Abstracts, Academic Dissertation).
PublicationType.evidence: "Publication Type" (table column header) and example row: "Abbreviations\nWorks consisting of lists of shortened forms of written words or phrases used for brevity. Acronyms are included here."

raw_full_info.example_row: Abbreviations: Works consisting of lists of shortened forms of written words or phrases used for brevity. Acronyms are included here.

ScopeNote.name: Scope Note
ScopeNote.descr: Textual definition or explanatory note describing the meaning and usage of the Publication Type (free-text descriptive note).
ScopeNote.evidence: "Scope Note" (table column header) and example scope note: "Abstracts\nWorks consisting of lists of publications on a subject and that provide full annotated bibliographical information together with substantive summaries or condensations of the facts, ideas, or opinions presented in each publication listed. (From LC Subject Cataloging Manual)."

raw_full_info.example_scope: Abstracts: Works consisting of lists of publications on a subject and that provide full annotated bibliographical information together with substantive summaries or condensations of the facts, ideas, or opinions presented in each publication listed. (From LC Subject Cataloging Manual).

standards.notes: This extraction focuses on the tabular 'Publication Characteristics (Publication Types) with Scope Notes' content from the MeSH documentation. MeSH as a whole is a large hierarchical vocabulary; additional structured elements (Descriptors, Qualifiers, SCRs, XML/RDF formats, APIs) are described in the source but are presented as prose/documentation and downloadable data rather than as a single field-level metadata table in the provided pages.
